# Rafiq v0.5.7: ChatGPT models fixed

A fix for Sign in with ChatGPT: a connected ChatGPT account now lists its models, and
adding one works.

---

## 🔧 Fixed

- **Adding a model on a ChatGPT account failed.** The agent didn't accept ChatGPT as a
  provider when adding a model, so fetching the model list and saving were both refused
  (and the form showed "[object Object]"). Now it lists every model your plan offers;
  pick one, with nothing to type.
- **The model list stays fresh:** the one-hour sign-in is renewed before the list is
  fetched.
- **Readable errors everywhere:** an error the agent sends back as a list now reads as
  text, never "[object Object]".

## ✨ Smaller things

- **"Add model" on a connected account** (Settings → Connected accounts) when no model uses
  it yet: it opens the model form on that account, with its models already listed.
- Opening the model form on a sign-in provider (from the welcome too) picks your account
  and lists its models right away.

---

**Updating:** installed copies offer this update on their own. For a new install, download
`Rafiq_0.5.7_x64-setup.exe` below and check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.7_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```
